name: Villapinzón (Colombia)
description: Green field with a yellow diagonal band from the upper hoist to the lower fly.
history: Municipal flag of Villapinzón, a municipality in the department of Cundinamarca, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor. Spanish Wikipedia records the flag as adopted in 1981.

features.role: diagonal band from the upper hoist to the lower fly
